name: How does AKN Design Group handle cabinet hardware installation within a larger renovation project?

mainEntity.name: How does AKN Design Group handle cabinet hardware installation within a larger renovation project?

acceptedAnswer.text: As part of our comprehensive design-build process, AKN Design Group seamlessly integrates cabinet hardware installation into your larger renovation project. Once your custom cabinetry is in place, our skilled craftsmen meticulously install the selected hardware, paying close attention to alignment and consistency. This managed approach ensures that the installation is executed with precision, complementing the high-quality cabinetry and overall design, and contributes to the superior craftsmanship we deliver for luxury kitchens, spa-inspired bathrooms, or whole-home remodels. Our team coordinates all aspects, providing a single point of accountability.
acceptedAnswer.description: AKN Design Group integrates cabinet hardware installation into the renovation process after cabinetry is installed, ensuring precise and cohesive integration with the overall design.
